beats.lead: The famous origin story is shaky
beats.text: Murphy's law is said to come from a 1949 rocket sled test.
beats.note: Historians call that link "by no means secure".

beats.text: Sensors on a test harness read zero because some were wired backwards.
beats.note: Engineer Edward Murphy had proposed them for John Stapp's project.

beats.name: Augustus De Morgan
beats.role: Mathematician. Wrote that whatever can happen will happen, given enough trials.

beats.text: No use of "Murphy's law" has been found before 1951.
beats.note: Accounts of who coined it conflict.

beats.text: Even the law about things going wrong has an origin that went wrong.

beats.line: Check the story as well as the wiring.
